purpose: Make every taxonomy, boundary, crosswalk and completeness claim traceable to reviewable authority rather than plausibility or vendor convention.

authority_tiers.definition: Adopting instrument, official standard, legal nomenclature or normative manual issued by the adopting body.
Current registry, structure, explanatory note, correspondence or release maintained by the official custodian.
Definition or reporting classification issued by the competent regulator.
Method or classification published by the responsible intergovernmental, statistical or specialist public authority.
Official implementation data, code service or filing instruction that demonstrates operational use.
Peer-reviewed or professionally governed interpretation used only when primary evidence is unavailable.

source_rules: Prefer the adopting body or current custodian over aggregators, vendors and search snippets.
Record title, publisher, exact URL, access date, authority scope and limitations.
A draft, consultation, final classification and operational implementation are different statuses.
Record the exact edition and jurisdiction; a family name such as NAICS is insufficient.
For downloaded artifacts, record a cryptographic digest and refuse unexpected content on rebuild.
If an official source is paywalled, record access limits and do not reconstruct protected content from secondary copies.
A source can support only claims inside its declared authority scope.
Search results locate evidence but are not themselves cited evidence.
claim_rules: Every non-obvious machine claim has at least one evidence reference and a locator precise enough for a reviewer to find the support.
Mark derived statements as inference and state the reasoning; do not present them as direct source claims.
Record known defeaters, scope qualifications and transition conditions.
Counts from imported structures are reproducible derivations tied to an exact source digest.
Absence from a searched source is not evidence of nonexistence unless the source asserts exhaustive coverage.
No claim of global or industry completeness may be based solely on a KPI list, vendor catalog, sample use cases or one economic-activity classification.
crosswalk_evidence_rules: Prefer official bidirectional correspondence artifacts, but retain the actual published direction.
A code correspondence is not automatically semantic equivalence, record recoding, or time-series comparability.
Every mapping states source and target edition, member extent, relation, cardinality, aggregation semantics, statistical-unit compatibility, geography, time and inclusion/exclusion compatibility.
Partial-code mappings require extent qualifiers and may require period-specific allocation evidence.
Never invent allocation weights; use official or empirical period-specific weights with provenance, otherwise refuse allocation.
Transitive mapping is forbidden by default. It may be considered only for independently reviewed exact-equivalence chains with identical dimensions and no partial extents.
Product, provider, function, regulatory line, criticality and economic-activity mappings are cross-axis relations, never parent-child claims.
freshness_rules: Recheck live current-edition assertions at least every 90 days during active atlas construction.
Recheck immediately on custodian revision announcements, consultations, corrigenda or transition milestones.
Preserve superseded evidence and effective dates; do not overwrite historical editions.
A changed URL does not change semantic identity, but changed scope, concepts or structure requires a new edition identity.
refusal_conditions: No authoritative boundary source is available.
Source and target editions are missing.
A mapping would collapse different statistical units or concepts without qualification.
Required partial-code allocation has no authoritative or empirical basis.
The classification is draft but the requested use requires operational status.
Evidence conflicts and no adjudication has resolved the conflict.
